supersedes.reason: v1 recorded 4 of its 11 distinct first calls (BAND, CETUS, BEAMX as universe_unavailable; PUNDIX as clock_gate_failed) as skipped because one exchangeInfo or server-time read failed on a proxy TLS drop at freeze time, with no retry and no fallback to the previous perpetual list. The rule being tested is unchanged; only these operational defects are fixed.
supersedes.v1_at_migration: 4 completed primary events, 3 open positions; v1 takes no new calls and its byte-identical module copy core/research/next10xgem1_fade_v1_frozen.py settles the open ones. v1 and v2 results are reported separately, never pooled into the v2 decision sample.

hypothesis: A fresh unconditional long call from the Telegram channel @next10xgem1 is followed by a 24h price path worse than the same coin's recent 24h paths: shorting the Binance USDT perpetual at the first 5m open after the call and holding 24h beats the same coin's pre-entry 30-day hourly-start 24h short mean.

study.status: post-hoc hypothesis from 180 days of surviving posts; this forward ledger is its first independent test

source.receipt: first live receipt of the public preview https://t.me/s/next10xgem1, archived by the news collector (archive-only: no news item, no AI call)
source.collector_health: four latest live polls of the channel, each gap <= 600 s, latest no older than 600 s

labels.copied_from: scripts/research_telegram_new_kols.py at commit 1e9f9c1 (the code that sealed the 2026-10-25 labels)
labels.side: long calls only; each is faded with a short
labels.text: the first received revision only; later edits never rewrite a frozen label

universe: the call's ticker resolves (kol4-v1 resolve_symbol, 1000x prefixes included) to a Binance USD-M USDT perpetual with status TRADING in the newest exchangeInfo snapshot: refreshed every pass once older than 6 hours, and when a refresh fails the previous snapshot is used for up to 7 days

book.name: plain_24h
book.entry: first official 5m kline open at least 60 s after max(first receipt, freeze commit)
book.liquidation: a 5m high >= 2x entry before exit is a -100% result (1x collateral)

secondary_book.name: catastrophe_stop_50
secondary_book.stop: same entries; the first 5m bar whose high reaches 1.5x entry exits at that level, or at the bar's open if it opens beyond it, plus 0.5% slippage
secondary_book.role: descriptive only; not part of the pass or futility rule

funding: actual settlements between entry and exit from the latest-N public fundingRate query (no time-window parameters); a settlement within 60 s of either boundary counts only if adverse; unproven coverage is recorded as unavailable, never as zero

control.null: exact mean of every hourly-start 24h short on the same coin (same liquidation and stop rules, price-only, 20bps) whose window lies inside the 30 days before entry

primary_statistic: mean over primary-sample completed events of (plain_24h price-only net at 20bps minus the plain null mean)

sample.futility_rule: if the mean primary excess of the first 245 completed events is <= 0 the ledger stops taking new events

pass_rule: weekly block bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound of the mean primary excess > 0
mean primary excess without the single best event > 0
mean plain_24h price-only net at the 80bps stress cost > 0
independence: a call on a coin whose earlier position is still inside its 24h window, or a call arriving while 8 positions are open, is recorded as skipped and never settled
exclusions: not a first live receipt within 600 s of publication, a truncated text, or a revision after first observation (a visible edit at first receipt is allowed, as in the study)
no TRADING USDT perpetual for the ticker
collector health failed, or no Binance clock reading within 10 minutes (clock_unreachable), or the reading is beyond the limits (clock_gate_failed)
planned entry more than 30 minutes after publication
a predeclared gate (futility, review, maximum duration) is active
a 5m price path with a missing bar for 7 days after the planned exit (recorded as unavailable and counted)
operational_changes_from_v1: every public Binance read retries a proxy/TLS drop, connection reset or timeout up to 3 attempts; HTTP refusals (403/418/429) and invalid bodies are not retried
the perpetual list is refreshed ahead of calls on every pass, not only at freeze time
the clock check (5 reads, minimum round trip, |offset| <= 2 s, round trip <= 10 s) runs every 5 minutes; a freeze uses the last reading if it is at most 10 minutes old
a freeze without any clock reading in the last 10 minutes is excluded as clock_unreachable; a reading beyond the limits stays clock_gate_failed
